name: mosaik-workspace
description: Workspace for mosaik, a React component library for agent-built frontends, and its showcase.

scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:docs
scripts.check:format: npm run check:format:web && npm run check:format:docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tim3399/mosaik && npm run build -w @tim3399/mosaik && npm run typecheck -w mosaik-showcase
scripts.check: npm run check:format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tim3399/mosaik && npm run build -w mosaik-showcase
